goal: Deliver the Slice 0 contract-first foundation: spatial Compose workspace navigation, canonical FastAPI anonymous-device authentication, and isolated PostgreSQL/Alembic online persistence.
non_goals: Do not move sessions, chat, world trees, source bodies, graphs, model configuration, or secrets to PostgreSQL.
Do not expand ordinary sync beyond activity_progress, study_plan, sync_summary, and user_setting.
Do not implement real community content, review mode, companion mode, TTS, or unsigned design states.
Do not modify or retire the legacy PWA/Capacitor implementation.
Do not build a signed or release APK.
Do not open PostgreSQL production writes or perform a production cutover in this task.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace order is Weekly Dashboard, Session Home, Global Graph, Community, with Session Home as the initial page.
Challenge is vertically above Session Home with gesture-following drag, cancellation, snap, reverse navigation, and preserved back-button access.
Global Graph keeps canvas pan/zoom ownership and supports workspace paging only from the defined edge zones.
Canonical OpenAPI and FastAPI expose anonymous bootstrap, refresh, me, session listing, and session revoke with request IDs and canonical errors.
Protected online writes derive account identity from the Bearer subject and never trust body userId.
The online SQLAlchemy metadata is isolated from legacy db.py and contains only approved /api/v1 online tables.
Alembic upgrades an empty PostgreSQL database and the previous revision to head without metadata drift.
PostgreSQL CI contract tests exist and reject learning-data tables, secret plaintext, and non-whitelisted sync types.
Focused Python and Android tests pass; unavailable PostgreSQL daemon and device checks are recorded honestly.
No release APK is assembled and no unrelated dirty-worktree changes are reverted.
do_not_touch: Native Room entities, DAOs, schema exports, and migrations
Legacy Python learning tables in db.py
notes: Three GPT-5.6-Sol xhigh Codex tasks share the checkout and therefore must not commit concurrently.
Room remains the local authority for core learning data; PostgreSQL authority is limited to /api/v1 online business data.
The safe SQLite fallback window ends before PostgreSQL accepts any production write.
